parameters: You don't need to buzz anyone on the intercom right now.
You get \P[2]'s attention and point and gesture at the intercom.
\P[2] and you have been through this before, and your girlfriend knows exactly what you need help with and how to get it.  She calmly
pushes a few buttons on the intercom, buzzing your butler, Frank.
"Hi Frank, this is \P[2].  I'm with \P[1] in one of the shops in the back.  My boyfriend is decapitated again, and
doesn't have a head right now to re-attach.  Can you please help us?  I'm sure he could pour something down his neck, like last time,
and then use that to grow a new head."
Frank's face shows on the display.  He seems ready-as-ever to help out.
Without showing annoyance, and without hesitation, Frank springs into action.
"Okay, sit tight.  I'm on my way.  I've got one of those nutrition drinks handy.  Need me to grab anything else?"
"No, we don't need anything else.  Thank you, Frank.  We appreciate it."
"Frank!  Hey man, I need some help - I'm decapitated and need to get my head back on or something, and you know how Mom and Dad are about
me going back inside the house like this.  I'm in one of the shops out back."
Frank's face shows on the display.  You and him are used to each other, and though you don't think about it, and probably aren't
aware of it, he's used to you not identifying yourself on the phone or intercom, as well as pulling the 'Hi, its me..." thing
without saying who on Earth 'me' is.  With your sixteen-year-old brain, you're actually totally oblivious to how much he bends
over backwards for you over the years with things like that.
